kv17.6:1.4: Nanu Saṃgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalīkaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti?
kv17.6:1.6: Hañci Saṃgho āhuneyyo --pe-- lokassa, tena vata re vattabbe
kv17.6:2.4: Nanu cattāro purisayugā, aṭṭha purisapuggalā dakkhiṇeyyā vuttā Bhagavatā ti?
kv17.6:2.6: Hañci cattāro purisayugā, aṭṭha purisapuggalā dakkhiṇeyyā vuttā Bhagavatā, tena vata re vattabbe
kv17.6:3.4: Nanu atthi keci Saṃghassa dānaṃ dentīti?
kv17.6:3.6: Hañci atthi keci Saṃghassa dānaṃ denti, tena vata re vattabbe
kv17.6:3.8: Nanu atthi keci Saṃghassa cīvaraṃ denti,
kv17.6:3.16: Hañci atthi keci Saṃghassa cīvaraṃ denti, piṇḍapātaṃ denti, senāsanaṃ denti, gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ denti, khādanīyaṃ denti, bhojanīyaṃ denti --pe-- pānīyaṃ denti, tena vata re vattabbe
kv17.6:7.5: Na vattabbaṃ "Saṃgho dakkhiṇaṃ paṭi- gaṇhātīti" kathā. 1.
